verdict.rationale: 1Password has no evidenced built-in natural-language interface. However, its official Environments MCP Server (Beta) lets agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Kiro manage 1Password Environments, so users can operate part of the product through natural-language prompts in an external agent. Its public docs MCP server only serves documentation, not product operation. Missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface in the 1Password apps, MCP coverage beyond Environments (vaults, items, sharing), a non-beta release, and hands-on evidence of NL operation working in practice.
